notes: 0.2.2：托盘右键「运行中」里的每个脚本现在是真子菜单，悬停即可向右展开脚本自己的托盘菜单，选中项直接执行；脚本列表与托盘里的脚本名不再带 .ahk 后缀；托盘各级菜单去掉了左侧预留的勾选列空白，含勾选或图标的菜单仍保持标准对齐。
notes_en: 0.2.2: each running script in the tray menu's Running submenu is now a real nested submenu - hovering opens the script's own tray menu to the side and picking an item runs it; script names in the list and the tray drop the .ahk suffix; menus no longer reserve a blank check-mark column on the left, while menus that actually show checks or icons keep the standard alignment.
